title: University of Edinburgh Global Excellence Scholarship
field: Arts, Humanities, Science, Engineering, Medicine, Social Sciences, Law
description: The University of Edinburgh Global Excellence Scholarship supports outstanding international students to pursue taught master's programs at one of the UK's top universities. The scholarship is awarded based on academic merit.
amount: Up to £10,000 towards tuition fees for the duration of the program
eligibility: International students commencing a full-time taught master's program; outstanding academic achievement; offer of admission from University of Edinburgh required

title: University of Manchester Global Futures Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Humanities, Social Sciences, Health Sciences, Law
description: The Global Futures Scholarship at the University of Manchester supports talented international students from around the world to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate studies. It recognizes academic excellence and future leadership potential.
amount: £5,000 to £20,000 depending on program and nationality; applicable as tuition fee discount
eligibility: International students from eligible countries; offer of admission to University of Manchester; strong academic record with excellent grades

title: University of Bristol Think Big Scholarship
field: Arts, Engineering, Science, Social Sciences, Law, Health Sciences, Life Sciences
description: The University of Bristol Think Big Scholarship invests in the futures of talented international students. The scholarship supports undergraduate and postgraduate studies across all disciplines at this prestigious Russell Group university.
amount: Undergraduate: £6,500 to £13,000 per year; Postgraduate: £6,500, £13,000, or £26,000 depending on award level
eligibility: International students from outside the EU; offer of admission to University of Bristol; excellent academic track record

title: King's College London International Scholarship
field: Law, Medicine, International Relations, Business, Arts, Science, Health Sciences
description: King's College London offers a range of international scholarships including the King's International Scholarship and the King's Master's Scholarship for high-achieving students from around the world.
amount: King's International Scholarship: £25,000; King's Master's Scholarship: £10,000 to £20,000; various PhD studentships with full funding
eligibility: International students with exceptional academic credentials; offer of admission from KCL; demonstrated leadership and extracurricular achievements

title: University of Glasgow International Leadership Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Business, Social Sciences, Education, Medicine
description: The University of Glasgow International Leadership Scholarship is awarded to high-caliber international students entering postgraduate taught programs. It recognizes students who demonstrate leadership qualities and academic excellence.
amount: £10,000 tuition fee discount for the first year of study
eligibility: International students with offer for a full-time postgraduate taught program; strong academic record; demonstrated leadership experience in community or professional settings

title: University of Warwick Global Excellence Scholarship
field: Business, Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Social Sciences, Law
description: The University of Warwick Global Excellence Scholarship supports outstanding international students to pursue taught master's programs. Warwick is consistently ranked among the UK's top universities and the scholarship attracts top global talent.
amount: £10,000 to £20,000 tuition fee reduction; some full tuition awards available
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic achievements; offer of admission from Warwick; must demonstrate potential to contribute to the university community

title: University of Leeds International Excellence Scholarship
field: Engineering, Business, Science, Arts, Social Sciences, Medicine, Environmental Studies
description: The University of Leeds offers the International Excellence Scholarship to high-achieving international students entering undergraduate and postgraduate programs. Leeds is a prestigious Russell Group university with a global reputation.
amount: Up to £7,500 per year for undergraduate; up to £10,000 for master's programs; applied as tuition fee reduction
eligibility: International students with strong academic background; offer of admission from University of Leeds; must meet English language requirements

title: University of Southampton International Merit Scholarship
field: Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Law, Arts, Medicine, Oceanography
description: The University of Southampton International Merit Scholarship rewards high-achieving international students with tuition fee reductions. Southampton is a world-leading research university and a founding member of the Russell Group.
amount: Undergraduate: £3,000 to £5,000 per year; Postgraduate: £3,000 to £9,000 depending on program
eligibility: International students paying overseas tuition fees; offer of admission required; academic excellence in previous qualifications

title: University of Sydney International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Arts, Medicine, Law, Architecture
description: The University of Sydney International Scholarship provides outstanding international students with financial support for postgraduate research degrees at one of Australia's premier universities. It is funded by the university and covers tuition fees and a living stipend.
amount: Full tuition fee coverage plus annual stipend of AUD 40,109 for up to 3.5 years for PhD; health cover included
eligibility: International students commencing full-time research degree; outstanding academic record and research potential; must have offer of admission

title: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarship
field: Science, Engineering, Medicine, Arts, Business, Law, Education, Agriculture
description: The Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarship provides financial support for high-achieving international students to pursue a research degree at Australia's number one university. It includes full tuition and a generous living allowance.
amount: Full tuition fee offset for up to 4 years; annual living allowance of AUD 37,000; relocation grant of AUD 3,000; OSHC health cover
eligibility: International students applying for a graduate research degree; exceptional academic record; research proposal required; meeting English language requirements

title: UNSW International Research Training Program (iRTP)
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Law, Arts, Medicine, Built Environment
description: The University of New South Wales International Research Training Program provides tuition fee coverage and a living stipend to exceptional international research students. UNSW is a member of Australia's prestigious Group of Eight universities.
amount: Full tuition fee scholarship; annual stipend of AUD 37,684; ancillary costs support up to AUD 10,000 per year
eligibility: International students commencing a research degree; strong research background; academic publications preferred; meeting minimum entry requirements

title: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Business, Law, Asia-Pacific Studies, Environment
description: The Australian National University Chancellor's International Scholarship offers tuition fee reductions to outstanding international students from diverse regions. ANU is Australia's national university and a world leader in research and education.
amount: 25% to 50% tuition fee reduction for the entire program duration; up to full tuition for exceptional candidates
eligibility: International students applying for full-time coursework programs; strong academic achievement; offer of admission from ANU required

title: University of Queensland International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Business, Health, Agriculture, Law, Humanities
description: The University of Queensland offers the UQ International Excellence Scholarship for high-achieving international students. UQ is a founding member of Australia's Group of Eight and a global top-50 university.
amount: Undergraduate and Master: 25% tuition fee reduction per year; PhD: full tuition and living stipend AUD 35,000 per year
eligibility: International students with outstanding academic records; meet program entry requirements; demonstrate extracurricular achievements

title: Monash University International Merit Scholarship
field: Engineering, IT, Science, Business, Arts, Medicine, Pharmacy, Design
description: The Monash University International Merit Scholarship rewards high-achieving international students with annual tuition fee grants. Monash is a world top-50 university and a member of the Group of Eight.
amount: AUD 10,000 per year for the duration of the degree; up to AUD 50,000 total for undergraduate programs
eligibility: International students commencing full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework; minimum academic average of 85% or equivalent; offer of admission required

title: University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Business, Law, Medicine, Education, Architecture
description: The University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship supports high-achieving international students across all faculties at New Zealand's top-ranked university. It recognizes academic merit and leadership potential.
amount: Up to NZD 10,000 per year towards tuition fees for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework; full tuition and stipend for PhD
eligibility: International students with excellent academic records; offer of admission required; demonstrated involvement in school or community activities

title: University of Otago International Research Scholarship
field: Sciences, Health Sciences, Humanities, Business, Law, Medicine, Environmental Studies
description: The University of Otago International Research Scholarship provides full funding for outstanding international doctoral candidates. Otago is New Zealand's oldest university and a world leader in research excellence.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver for 3 years; annual stipend of NZD 32,544; research support fund; conference travel grants
eligibility: International students pursuing a PhD; outstanding academic record; strong research proposal; support from an Otago supervisor required

title: Victoria University of Wellington International Excellence Scholarship
field: Arts, Science, Engineering, Business, Law, Design, Architecture, Education
description: Victoria University of Wellington offers the International Excellence Scholarship to support high-achieving international students. Located in New Zealand's capital city, the university is known for its research excellence and vibrant campus life.
amount: NZD 5,000 to NZD 10,000 per year towards tuition fees; duration of program up to 3 years
eligibility: International students entering full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework; strong academic record; offer of admission required

title: University of Canterbury International Scholarship
field: Engineering, Science, Arts, Business, Law, Forestry, Education, Antarctic Studies
description: The University of Canterbury International Scholarship supports talented international students at all levels of study. UC is renowned for its engineering and science programs and its beautiful campus in Christchurch.
amount: Undergraduate: NZD 10,000-20,000 per year; Master: NZD 15,000; PhD: full tuition plus NZD 30,000 annual stipend
eligibility: International students with strong academic background; meet program entry requirements; demonstrate community involvement or leadership
